name: Adrián Garzón
headline: Corporate IT Senior Manager and PM
about:
Highly qualified professional with more than 40 years of experience and specialization in the sale and delivery of services to clients for a large number of IT solutions, including software, hardware, World Class applications and communication networks.
Great ability and broad experience to lead and manage high-level expert and specialized professionals in complex projects through the effective leadership in high-performance teams in adverse situations. Responsible and flexible in decision-making, with critical thinking and excellent analytical skills, communication and strategic vision.
Specially oriented to the resolution of IT complex problems, with big passion for learning, sharing and transmitting knowledge.
Special knowledge in managing professional services and technology areas as PMP in a wide variety of business applications.
Seriously committed to taking the initiative with high levels of self-motivation, responsibility, energy, commitment, attitude and professional ethics.
